summary: v5.1 backend regression — 30/30 pytest pass after one critical fix to /api/lottery/manual (ObjectId leak). All 12 integrations + 7 scheduled jobs + 11 telegram commands present in Settings. Lottery dedicated scan, manual add → settle → track-record flow verified end-to-end. Trade Floor AI Journal write-back confirmed live via direct invocation of services.trade_floor._write_journal_entries — Claude generated a 4-6 sentence entry and persisted it to tf_journal collection. Two spec-vs-impl gaps flagged (non-blocking, naming only).

critical.issue: Returned 500 (ValueError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable). Root cause: services/lottery.py:add_manual_play returned the inserted doc with Mongo _id ObjectId in it. FIXED by adding doc.pop('_id', None) before return.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exist (404). Spec asked for {active_positions, closed_positions} split. Only /api/performance/summary is implemented (returns {signals, options}).
Endpoint does not exist (404). Options performance data is currently available only inside /api/performance/summary -> 'options' sub-key.
Spec asked for fields 'significance_score' and 'activist_filer' — actual fields are 'significance' and 'activist'. Naming gap only; data is present.
Spec said it must write a 'peak_gain' field on settlement — impl writes 'realized_pct' + retains the running 'peak_price' marker but does not emit a 'peak_gain' field on the settled doc.

Spec asked for {total_plays, win_rate, avg_pnl, best, worst}. Impl returns {total_plays, settled, winners, losers, win_rate, avg_winner_pct, avg_loser_pct, total_pnl_pct, history} — no 'best'/'worst' aggregates.

action_items: Decide whether to add /api/performance and /api/performance/options routes that return the v5.1-spec {active_positions, closed_positions} + options list — frontend Performance page is consuming /performance/summary today; if spec is the contract, add the routes (else update the spec).

Rename SEC filing fields to match v5.1 spec ('significance_score', 'activist_filer') OR update the spec to match impl ('significance', 'activist'). Frontend SECPage already renders them — confirm which name the UI uses before renaming.
Optionally extend lottery settle to also write a 'peak_gain' field = (peak_price - entry_price)/entry_price*100 — currently only realized_pct is recorded.
critical_code_review_comments: services/lottery.py:add_manual_play used to return the Motor insert doc directly — leaked '_id' ObjectId → FastAPI 500. Pattern repeats; recommend a project-wide _clean_doc helper or apply find_one with {'_id': 0} projection style everywhere a write is followed by a return.

services/trade_floor.py:_write_journal_entries: works as designed — Claude was reached via claude_service._call_claude and produced a coherent 4-6 sentence journal entry. No retries/back-off if Claude returns None (silent skip). Consider logging skip count.

services/trade_floor.py:evaluate_and_execute (line 267): asyncio task is raising AttributeError('list' object has no attribute 'keys') when row.get('signals') is a list, not dict. Background task only — does not surface as HTTP error but pollutes logs and silently drops the gate-check signal trail. Fix: `(row.get('signals') or {}) if isinstance(row.get('signals'), dict) else dict.fromkeys(row.get('signals') or [])`.

services/db.py:get_db caches a single Motor client at module level; any test that constructs a new event loop hits 'attached to a different loop'. Tests must reset db._client = None when re-entering. Consider moving to a factory pattern or per-loop cache.
Endpoint shape drift between spec and impl (Performance, SEC field names, peak_gain) — recommend an OpenAPI/spec snapshot test that diffs response keys against expected v5.1 contract.

rca of the issue: Bug — POST /api/lottery/manual returned HTTP 500: services/lottery.py add_manual_play() built a doc with services.db.stamped(), inserted via lottery_manual_plays.insert_one(doc) (which mutates doc in-place to attach the Mongo ObjectId at key '_id'), then returned doc. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId → raises ValueError -> 500. Repro: curl -X POST .../api/lottery/manual -d '{ticker:TEST,entry_price:5.5}' → 500. Fix: doc.pop('_id', None) prior to return. Verified — test_01_manual_add now returns 200 with the play object; full lottery flow (add → list → settle → track-record) passes.
